title: Prove optimal sparse-union headers: 44 to 19 bits (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove the minimum fixed width of the complete legal coordinate/tag header domain in Mihir Srivastava's PR4583, and attain it with a new mixed-radix codec. Claim type: scoped written construction and sharp information bound, with exact finite corroboration. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas.

```text
legal sentinel block: L^g states
legal axis-i block:   |E_i| L^(g-1) states
joint index:         N = L^(g-1) (L + sum_i |E_i|)
minimum width:       2 + ceil(log2 N), including marker 01
```

At L=16, g=4 and E_i={0,15}, the new representation uses 19 bits for all 98,304 legal states. The separate-field format uses 44. In general the saving is at least gh+g+b bits, for h=ceil(log2 L), b=ceil(log2(g+1)). Every coordinate, flag, ordinal, count and tag remains recoverable under the same shared context.

Credit Mihir Srivastava / mihir-s-05, PR4583, for the metadata contract and separate-field format; Cinna Davis / PR4100, Jeremy Kothe / PR1731, Vlado Vojdanovski / PR1673, Ryanson Jonathan / PR4327 and PR4590, unpaidmoon / PR4376, rtyu193-rgb and LeverRank for the retained lineage. Enumerative coding, mixed-radix indexing and pigeonhole lower bounds are classical. The new result is their exact application to this interface and the attaining codec. No predecessor scientific verifier was replayed or audited.

## Evidence

- Before: the cited contract stores separate fields in 2+2gh+g+2b bits. After: the new codec attains the matching fixed-width information lower bound.
- Local warning-strict normal and optimized checks pass with identical generated receipts: 1,196 contexts, 57,744 complete legal states, 105,120 retags/line keys, 22,022 rejected unused codes, sixty larger round trips and 27 explicit invalid-input controls.
- Both registered commands passed, timed locally at 1.735 and 1.721 seconds for the direct checks. Each has a 120-second timeout.
- Two mathematical code mutations and one actual source-file corruption are rejected. Source pins, committed bytes, executable modes and source ancestry pass at 198ffb11a8bb82c71d7dafb6a5cb137728b01362.
- Official export integrity passes. Read-only, Git-free normal and optimized replay with an empty PATH passes; all ten exported files including the inventory remain unchanged.

From the worktree root, reproduce with the local interpreter path or another CPython 3.12 installation:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/union-state-header/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/union-state-header/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/union-state-header
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/union-state-header --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected markers are PASS_UNION_STATE_HEADER, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES. Direct checks print generated receipts bound to the seven package files and both source inputs, and write nothing. The all-size claim rests on PROOF.md.

## Limitations

This optimizes individual fixed-width representation with a shared context and fixed marker. It does not price boundary rank/select access, context storage, large-integer temporaries or decoding travel. Retagging can rewrite the whole index; the old tag-local update guarantee is not retained. It is not an arbitrary-dirty reversible retagging implementation or an error-detecting code. The implementation has explicit finite capacities; the written construction covers all finite contexts.

No physical caller, faster reader, complete emitter, tape-time saving, new kappa, selected-frontier update or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. All five selected assumptions remain. The selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human review and proof-kernel review are unrun or unclaimed.

## Open next questions

Can one actual union invocation pay for this representation? Bind one carving description to rank/select access and charge every header read, rewrite, temporary and context-delivery step through one complete round. Those missing physical costs block an operational saving.

## Related open work

No open PR studying this union-header width was found in the complete 572-open-PR overlap snapshot, the fresh latest-100 list and targeted live searches. PR4583 and PR4590 are merged predecessors; the latter checks the old format rather than constructing this representation. Sparse local notes, arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain overlap limits. The advance [CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19375380) records the scope and provenance.
